text:
I've been visiting this clinic for over eight years, receiving treatments like fillings, scaling, root canal therapy, and crowns.

Dr. Piriya stands out for her meticulous and skilful approach; her expertise is evident in every procedure. I especially appreciate how gentle she is during anaesthetic injections – absolutely pain-free and very reassuring. She is incredibly caring and attentive, always making sure her patients are comfortable.

🚅The clinic is conveniently located just a two-minute walk from MRT Wongsawang (violet line).

🗒Please note, if you need a local anaesthetic for fillings, there’s an additional charge of 200 baht.

📍Highly recommend this clinic for anyone seeking quality dental care.📍
